categories.title: Breakouts
categories.description: Getting the puck out of your own zone against different forechecks.

categories.title: Forecheck
categories.description: Pressure in the opponent's zone to win the puck back or force a bad exit.

categories.title: Neutral zone
categories.description: Trapping the opponent's attack, and regrouping with speed when you have the puck.

categories.title: Offensive zone
categories.description: Keeping possession in the attacking zone and turning it into shots with traffic.

categories.title: Power play
categories.description: 5-on-4 setups. The player in the penalty box is simply not in the script.

categories.title: Penalty kill
categories.description: 4-on-5 shapes that protect the middle and clear the puck.

categories.title: Faceoffs
categories.description: Set plays off the draw in both zones.

plays.title: Up the wall
plays.when: Wall open, F1 on the D. The default first option.

plays.title: Up to low centre
plays.when: F2 sits on our wall winger. Short middle outlet to the swinging centre.

plays.title: Over (D-to-D)
plays.when: Strong side flooded. Change sides behind the net and go up the far wall.

plays.title: Wheel
plays.when: D1 has speed and no pressure low. Carry behind the net, D2 is the pick.

plays.title: Reverse
plays.when: F1 follows the wheel tight. Bank it off the end boards back to D2.

plays.title: Rim up the wall
plays.when: No time for a clean pass. Rim it, the winger bumps to the centre.

plays.title: Stretch
plays.when: Two forecheckers deep. Over, then a long pass to the flying weak-side wing.

plays.title: Five-man exit
plays.when: Controlled exit with numbers. Centre through the middle, D1 jumps up.

plays.title: 2-1-2 aggressive
plays.when: Chasing a goal, after an icing, or against slow D. Two deep, one high, D pinch.

plays.title: 1-2-2 contain
plays.when: Protecting a lead or against fast teams. F1 angles, F2 jumps the wall pass.

plays.title: 1-2-2 trap
plays.when: Slow a fast team down: steer the carrier to the boards and close the trap at the red line.

plays.title: Regroup with swings
plays.when: The neutral zone is clogged: D-to-D while the forwards curl back, then attack with speed.

plays.title: Low cycle
plays.when: Possession low: protect, leave it for the next man, loop, and hit the slot when they collapse.

plays.title: Low to high, point shot
plays.when: The defence sinks low: move it to the point, walk the line and shoot through a screen.
Shooters on both flanks and a strong bumper. Includes a bank pass to the goal line.

plays.title: Umbrella
plays.when: A big shot up top: move it high and across quickly, one-timer from the far flank.

plays.title: Box
plays.when: The default kill. The box shifts with the puck, then block and clear.

plays.title: Diamond
plays.when: Against an umbrella (three high, two low). Whoever the puck comes to steps out.

plays.title: O-zone win to the point
plays.when: Win it back, the D walks into the lane and shoots, wingers screen and crash.

plays.title: Quick blast
plays.when: A clean draw straight back to the off-wing shooter lined up inside for a one-timer.

plays.title: D-zone win to breakout
plays.when: The default D-zone faceoff: win to the corner D, winger pops for the outlet.
